reviews.text: I used to be a long time client until I moved to the suburbs. I still haven't found a veterinarian office that compares to Heal. My cat had a health scare and I didn't want to take him anywhere else except to Heal. I knew they would go above and beyond. Naturally, they did. My boy is now calm at home.

Do not come to this clinic.  They overcharge and scam people.  I brought my dog in for diarrhea a few weeks ago and the vet had convinced me my dog may have a liver disease and a possible GI disorder.  About $600 charge overall and a lot of stress to find out it was just Giardia.
I brought my dog in again a few days ago for limping.  They took X-rays and did blood work.  Said they couldn't determine what her injury was and had to send her images to a radiologist (for an extra $200 charge).  They just called me and said the radiologist could not determine what her issue was either.  Told me to go to Med Vet to see an orthopedic specialist.  Heal Veterinary Clinic is expensive and useless.

Wouldn’t recommend bringing your cat here. The vet was knowledgeable but they refused to do any tests on or even try to give my cat anything. My cat really disliked one of the techs who grabbed her like she was a sack of potatoes, keep in mind he never gets upset at the vet. I think they were too busy this day because there was a long wait so they didn’t want to run any tests or take their time. but also seems like they are not equipped to handle normal car behavior
10/10 would recommend. It was easy to make an appointment, the clinic was clean/inviting and Dr. Baethke did a great job with our dog (who gets nervous around men).
Dr Landini and his team are absolutely amazing. They take care of all my animals, and only trust them with my dogs.
Wouldn't take our babies anywhere else!

Great  service vets and staff handling with love and care
Clean spaces
Relaxin atmosphere .
Happy to take my pest for for  over 15 years .
Thank you Heal🩵

We brought our cat here today and saw Dr. Freddy. Freddy and the entire team were incredible. You can tell they are all very passionate about what they do, and have so much love for their patients. Highly highly recommend!

I’ve been bringing my dog here for years and have always had a really good experience. The staff clearly knows what they’re doing, and they’ve been consistent and reliable every time. They’re kind, attentive, and I fully trust them with my dog’s care.

Have been going to Heal Vet for 30 + years. Pets have seen Dr Landini,  Dr. Rasmussen, Dr Leahy, Dr Kotev and most recently Dr Freddy who spent extra time helping my cat through his lunch hour. All have provided exceptional care. Vet techs are amazing and helpful supporting home care. Highly recommend.

Brought my bunny hear for his annual check-up. I’m glad that they let me in the exam room, this wasn’t the case before when I first came here and with the other vet place. I could comfort my bunny while he gets acquainted with the new environment. The orderlies were nice and gentle with him. Dr. Landini is also quite pleasant. They were quick even with a little wait time, we were in and out within a  hour.

I will start with this to be fair…everyone we have worked with at Heal has been kind and cordial. The front desk staff is nice and the medical staff seemed to be very knowledgeable and trustworthy. We have taken both of our dogs there even since we first took them home and until recently had no concerns about doing so.

We noticed a sizable lump on our older dog’s leg in mid-July. As we were concerned, we brought her in as soon as possible to have it looked at. They aspirated it and drained it of fluid and informed us that it was simply a hematoma, and that it should stay noticeably smaller now and ebb over time. They called us back a few days later to check on her as they usually do, and while she was acting normally, we reported that the lump was almost back to its original size. They informed us that was likely just swelling and after a while it would decrease in size. We trusted them as we always had.

We waited for it to go down in size and it never did. Maybe we waited too long and that we can take responsibility for, but two months later we returned to Heal because it was still there…in fact it was now larger. They ran a few more tests and came to the conclusion that it should be biopsied. We scheduled that at another office per their direction so as to have it done by an accredited surgeon. The results came back as cancer.

Now, I am not blaming Heal for my dog’s condition. It was clear now that it was cancerous from the beginning and that obviously isn’t their fault. But I am blaming Heal for the misdiagnosis. Had they done their homework and the appropriate testing in July, and told us why it was important to do so, we would likely be much further into her treatment and she may be well into recovery. As it is, we are in the midst of some very difficult adjustments for her and it remains to be seen as to whether action was taken too late.

Once again, the staff is nice and when it comes to the basics, they seem fine. But when it really counted they dropped the ball. We are seriously considering a new primary veterinary office as a result.
my Rottweiler Rico is difficult at the vet, but they’ve always been patient and fair with him. Always provide sound advice and they genuinely care for the animals under their watch.

I've been coming to this veterinary clinic for several years and have always appreciated the kindness and professionalism of the front desk staff. The receptionists were thoughtful and genuinely cared about my dog, which made every visit feel welcoming. Unfortunately, my recent experiences have been quite different. A new front desk staff member—whose name I don’t recall, but she has pink hair—has been consistently rude, inattentive, and slow. It’s clear she lacks the compassion that’s so important in this environment. After several disappointing interactions, I’ve made the difficult decision to look for a vet.

I’ve been taking my dog here for a few years now and am very thankful to have found Heal! They are consistent, friendly and professional. Special shout-out to the front desk team who is just the sweetest and always so helpful. Thank you Heal!

They have always taken care of my pets with such compassion and love. Always willing to answer any and all questions.

I appreciate their staff every time I have a scare and need to get in last minute. Offering well thought out plans, next steps and potential outcomes.
I stopped in with an emergency with my cat. They were very caring about took great care of us. I highly recommend.

The staff at heal are so kind, accommodating and helpful. I have been taking my dog here for over 8 years, and can’t imagine going anywhere else. Dr. Leahey is rockstar. She has been treating my dog with diabetes, was able to diagnose him when it happened and has been an incredibly supportive and informative Dr who genuinely cares about his well being. I always recommend any friends looking for a vet to go to Heal.

Dr. Landini is truly one of a kind. His knowledge, compassion, and genuine care are unmatched. He took the time to explain everything clearly, helped ease my anxiety about my pet’s dental cleaning, and gave me peace. I’ve never been treated with such kindness and respect by a vet. He’s incredibly trustworthy and thorough, and his staff is just as friendly and supportive. I’m so grateful to have found him — he goes above and beyond in every way.
everyone I've interacted with is kind and caring. always a good experience, even for my cat 😺 …
We’ve been coming here for years and the staff is amazing and very accommodating. Would recommend
Great vet office. Caring staff, very kind, genuine and professional. Dr. Landini is the best.

I had an amazing experience bringing my big baby Ramen here! The staff and veterinarian were incredibly knowledgeable and handled my anxious boy with ease. The prices are reasonable, and the facility is spotless. We left very happy after our annual check-up.

A special shout-out to Lindsay at the front desk, who was an absolute sweetheat. So accommodating and welcoming.

I am extremely disappointed with this vet clinic. We recently took our cat here for an evaluation since we just had a baby and our regular vet is an hour away.

First off, they refused to review our cat’s existing x-rays, insisting instead that we use their own radiology service for something we were already aware of.

Then, they sold us a medication at a 500% markup! I understand it’s a business, but this is outrageous—charging $2.90 per pill when the actual cost is just 24 cents! When we needed a refill, they tried to direct us to their own online pharmacy, and that’s when I discovered the extreme price difference. We simply can’t afford to pay these inflated prices, so I found an online vet pharmacy with fair prices and requested the vet to send over the prescription.

They promised to email the prescription the next day and told us we could pick up more meds in person since we were running out. However, no emails, no follow-up—nothing.

Today, I stopped by to pick up the promised refill, only to be told it wasn’t in stock, despite them confirming with my wife the day before that it would be ready. The front desk staff, particularly ‘Briana’, was extremely rude and gave me attitude when I asked why our prescription copies hadn’t been emailed.

She gave me the runaround, saying the vet refused because other online pharmacies might sell versions that are unsafe for dogs—excuse me, but this is a cat we’re talking about. After spending over a thousand dollars at their practice, this was completely unacceptable. It took nearly 20 minutes and almost causing a scene to finally get the prescription copies so we could go elsewhere.

It’s clear they refused to cooperate because they wouldn’t profit from us anymore. The unprofessionalism is astounding—this isn’t even the first issue we’ve had, as we’ve also experienced problems with not receiving lab results.

Avoid this place unless you enjoy being price gouged. They are shameless, and the front desk staff, especially Dakota and Briana, are rude and unprofessional. I will gladly drive an hour next time to visit an honest, friendly, and compassionate vet. This place is not it.
The best vet ever!!! So sweet and so kind
Great place , very clean and the best animal care in the city of Chicago, I recommend everyone take your animals here for the Best care they can Get !!!

Our dogs have been coming here for almost a decade. The vets and staff really love their patients and take good care of them. Our dogs are getting older and need care more frequently - we can always rely on this clinic for help. Dr. Landini and Dr. Rasmussen have been especially amazing when caring for our elder dog with cancer and chronic pancreatic problems. We really trust this team. Thanks from our pups Audrey & Wilma!

We have had great experiences across the board with this office. We went with our senior dog who needed a check up and referral for physical therapy. Dr. Leahy was very thorough and kind. Our senior dog later wasn't doing well and Dr. …
Been going to heal forever. Never had a bad outcome. They really treat my pets as their own.

My sister and I and have been going to Heal well over 10 years. The front desk staff is very welcoming. The facility is nice and clean. Special shout out to Dr. Leahy who is very friendly and a knowledgeable vet! Mario, Monty, Mietze, Sonny, Schnitzel & Sage say thank you!
My pets and I ALWAYS receive top-notch service and the best care.

My dog Lucy has been coming to heal for a couple of years now! I always love to see the way they interact with her and how understanding they are. It’s very noticeable that everyone at heal cares about the wellbeing of our animals. …
